dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit irregular, jagged perimeters with a sharp gradient transition from the dark exterior pelage to a high-intensity cream-colored boundary, surrounding a darker central core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid, high-intensity cream-colored pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily concentrated in the posterior-lateral quadrant and interspersed between larger annular structures.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent dorsal-central macro-annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle, with additional smaller blobs forming a linear chain-like relationship extending toward the posterior fluke area.
